name: Laura Smalley
credit: John Henry Faulk Recordings of Negro Religious Services (AFC 1941/016), American Folklife Center, Library of Congress
title: Interview with Laura Smalley, Hempstead, Texas, 1941

words.text: [sings : Old Ship of Zion while the Unidentified Woman Interviewer hums along]
[blurts— “Good!” in the middle of the song]
[Speaking in concert with the Unidentified Woman Interviewer]
[she makes a swish sound to imitate falling stars]
[recording begins with a fragment of the Unidentified Woman Interviewer's laughter]
[Mrs. Smalley appears to be showing the family photos]
